name: MTAC 338 254 MAX (MTAC, 254 gr)

ballisticCoefficients.note: G1 BC, printed ".720 (A.B.)". Marked (A.B.): independent testing (page footnote). Page footnote: "Highlighted bullets were tested through the Oehler 43 system"; which bullets is not read. The velocity it applies to is not stated.

G7 BC, printed ".369 (A.B.)". Marked (A.B.): independent testing (page footnote). Page footnote: "Highlighted bullets were tested through the Oehler 43 system"; which bullets is not read. The velocity it applies to is not stated.

sources.note: Page 3, MTAC - Match, Tactical: Caliber .338, Grains 254, Minimum Required Twist *1-10", Part Number MTAC 338 254 MAX, G1 BC .720 (A.B.), G7 BC .369 (A.B.), OAL 1.764", Bullet Projection 1.179"

note: The twist is marked "*"; page footnote: "*If shooting through transonic, a twist rate increase of 1 inch is recommended (ex: 1:9" instead of 1:10")". Bullet projection (from the SealTite band to the tip, page footnote) printed: 1.179". The same G1 .720 and G7 .369 are printed for LZR 338 265 GEN2.
